pr_title: Fix Sonos media_player control may fail when grouping speakers
pr_body:
## Proposed change
Fix issues related to grouping and ungrouping Sonos speakers that result in media_player state and services not working properly. Symptoms include imedia_player reporting incorrect media and service calls getting routed to the wrong speakers.  Examples from user include pressing play on the bathroom speaker and having the kitchen speaker play.

Fortunately, the issue reporter had a scenario that reproduced 100% of the time on my system; allowing detailed debugging to be done. The root cause may be Sonos updates changing the message sequence or existing code issues. Either way, tests have been added for these scenarios.

issue_context.title: Bug Sonos speaker grouping may result in media player controls not responding
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have 9 different Sonos speakers and home assistant is intermittently either mixing up the entities or not detecting that the sonos speaker is playing at all.

For instance, I play something in my family room Sonos speaker but media_player.sonos_bathroom is playing instead of media_player.sonos_family_room.
 
It has also happened where no HA media_players entities detects a Sonos speaker is playing.  A restart of the Sonos integration fixes it temporarily until it happens again.

I was able to reproduce the problem.  So far it seems to happen every time I switch speakers within my android Sonos app (newest version).  I posted on the HA subreddit and someone else had the exact same problem.

First noticed on 2024.5.3 but updated to 2024.6.1 and still same issue.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2024.6.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sonos

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos/

I believe I have the issue fixed.  It would be good to get some testing to see if it resolves your issue as I work on getting the PR ready for review.

Are you able to deploy a patch on your system?

We'd want to take the speaker.py and media_player.py files from this directory

https://github.com/PeteRager/core/tree/sonos-zgs/homeassistant/components/sonos

I've temporarily added a new attribute to the media_player that tracks the speakers coordinator. When speakers are grouped one of the speakers is the coordinator.  When speakers are not grouped they are their own coordinator. When you press the play/pause button on a speaker in HA, the command is routed to the coordinator of the group. So the experience of pressing play on one speaker and a different one plays was because the coordinators were not always being updated.

So a simple test screen can be made for when you do the testing, showing the media player, it's group members and what it's current coordinator is.

![sonos_group](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/76050312/2c518e62-5ccb-4535-bade-6e8140623b3d)

```
views:
  - title: Home
    panel: true
    cards:
      - type: horizontal-stack
        cards:
          - type: vertical-stack
            cards:
              - type: media-control
                entity: media_player.master_bedroom
              - type: entity
                entity: media_player.master_bedroom
                name: group
                attribute: group_members
              - type: entity
                entity: media_player.master_bedroom
                name: coordinator
                attribute: coordinator
          - type: vertical-stack
            cards:
              - type: media-control
                entity: media_player.porch
              - type: entity6
                entity: media_player.porch
                name: group
                attribute: group_members
              - type: entity
                entity: media_player.porch
                name: coordinator
                attribute: coordinator

```
